AGENDA
REGULAR MEETING OF THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item.Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City’s website under Parklands Committee Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.
The Parklands Committee, at the direction of the Committee Chair with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda. Note: Agenda topics may be continued to future Parklands Committee meetings.
ROLL CALL
CALL TO ORDER
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
PUBLIC WORK DIRECTOR'S REPORT
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
CITIZEN APPLICATION
1.
PC-578-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE THREE BRAZILIAN PEPPER TREES LOCATED IN THE RIGHT-OF-WAY ALLEY AT THE REAR OF 2425 PALOS VERDES DRIVE WEST
Applicant: Larry Lennemann, 2425 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the request to remove of the three Brazilian pepper trees, and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request to remove of the three Brazilian pepper trees; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
2.
PC-580-24; APPLICATION TO REMOVE FOUR EUCALYPTUS TREES LOCATED ADJACENT TO FAIRWAY SIX ON THE PALOS VERDES GOLF CLUB
Applicant: Palos Verdes Golf Club, 3301 Via Campesina, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee consider the following available actions: (1) Approve the request to remove four trees located on the PVGC, approve the installation of replacement Oak trees, and approve the Conditions of Approval; (2) Deny the request to remove four trees located on the PVGC; or (3) Provide alternative direction.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
3.
PROVIDE RECOMMENDATIONS TO STAFF ON THE TOP TWO PARKLANDS PRIORITIES TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE PARKLANDS COMMITTEE FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025
Recommendation: That the Parklands Committee provide recommendations to staff on the top two parklands priorities to be considered by the Parklands Committee for Fiscal Year 2024-2025.
Staff Report
COMMITTEE CHAIR AND COMMITTEE MEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Committee Chair and Committee Members to provide comments, reports on community activities, subcommittees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 12, 2024, 2024, AT 6:30 P.M.
Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
